NONE: › used to express surprise or strength of feeling
（表示驚奇或強烈感情）啊呀，天哪

example: Gosh, I didn't expect to see you here!
天哪，沒想到會在這兒看見你！

C: › [ C ] any of the four books of the Bible that contain details of the life of Jesus Christ
福音書（《聖經》中記載耶穌生平的四福音書之一）

U: › [ U ] informal also gospel truth the complete truth
（用於強調某事的真實性）絕對真實
› [ U ] also gospel music a style of religious music originally performed by black Americans
（起源於美國黑人中的）福音音樂

S: › [ S ] literary a set of principles or ideas that someone believes in

example: St Mark's Gospel/the Gospel according to St Mark
《馬可福音》
to preach/spread the gospel
講道／傳播福音
If Mary tells you something, you can take it as gospel.
瑪麗告訴你的事，你可以絕對相信。
the gospel of hard work
勤奮工作的信條

NONE: › the very thin thread that spiders produce to make webs
精巧輕盈的；輕薄精緻的

example: a gossamer veil
輕薄精緻的面紗

S or U: B2 [ S or U ] conversation or reports about other people's private lives that might be unkind, disapproving, or not true
（有關別人隱私的）流言蜚語，閒言閒語，閒聊

NONE: B2 to talk about other people's private lives
（對別人的隱私）說三道四，傳播流言蜚語

C: › [ C ] disapproving also gossipmonger someone who enjoys talking about other people and their private lives
愛說三道四的人；喜歡散佈流言蜚語的人

example: Her letter was full of gossip.
她信裡講的都是些閒言閒語。
I don't like all this idle gossip.
我討厭這些無聊的流言蜚語。
I've got some juicy gossip for you.
我有些特別有趣的小道傳聞告訴你。
Have you heard the (latest) gossip?
你聽到（最近流傳的）那些閒言閒語嗎？
UK Jane and Lyn sat in the kitchen having a good gossip about their friends.
簡和琳恩坐在廚房裡大聊特聊自己的那班朋友。
She's a terrible gossip.
她是個很要命的長舌婦。
Stop gossiping and do your work.
別再閒扯了，繼續工作去。
People have started to gossip about us.
人們已經開始說我們的閒話了。

NONE: › the part of a newspaper in which you find stories about the social and private lives of famous people
（報紙上關於名人社交或私生活的）漫談欄，茶話欄
